in_hebrew.name: Vigilia
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Vigilia הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Latin word 'vigilare' meaning 'to keep watch', Vigilia is a name of great significance in Christian tradition. It symbolizes the steadfast faith and unwavering watchfulness of those who keep guard over their beliefs and values. In the Bible, the word 'vigil' is used to describe the night watches of the faithful, and the name Vigilia is a reminder of their dedication and perseverance.

in_latin.name: Vigilia
in_latin.long_meaning: Vigilia noctis, nocturnus vigil, vel nocturna vigilia, est dies, noctis, aut horae ante dies, quae praecedunt dies, noctis autem post dies. Hoc nomen in Ecclesia ab initio usitatum est, ut dies ante nativitatem Domini nostri Jesu Christi, qui dies est dies noctis, et dies nocturnus, in qua noctu Domini natus est.
